scope: Opt-in synthetic Customers identity/lifecycle controller; existing auth and Dashboard routes unchanged
behaviors: missing identity refuses activation without creating a database
wrong target refuses activation without creating a vault
invalid account and resolver errors fail closed
verified supplied identity mounts locked, never auto-unlocks
account A reads only account A fixture
logout refresh immediately wipes drafts and plaintext
account switch opens a separate locked vault
identity change before save rejects old form without writing either vault
latest activation wins when vault opens overlap
reactivation of an active identity resets to locked without losing records
identity lost while opening cannot mount a late view
logout during decryption never publishes late plaintext
page exit locks and return never auto-unlocks
target change revokes existing session on identity refresh
disposal during pending activation cannot remount late UI
bugFixed: Teardown callbacks previously invalidated the next activation; inactive guards no longer advance generation and epoch is captured after teardown. Regression covers reactivation and identity loss during opening.

authReview.candidateLiveIdentity: userId from gateway header, fallback email; preview-owner in local preview
authReview.candidateIndependentOwnerIdentity: Target-specific chatgpt-auth wrapper re-exports requireOwnerUser; owner-auth uses fire-owner after signed-cookie validation
authReview.requiredBeforeRuntimeActivation: Explicit stable opaque account and fixed target mapping from validated server authentication, with immediate identity refresh on logout/account change

limits: Synthetic caller-supplied identities are not server authentication proof
No Dashboard/route integration or complete app build
No iPhone/iPad or mobile visual tests
Pagehide/pageshow events were dispatched in Chromium; not physical device lifecycle evidence
Idle tested with short synthetic policy; default five minutes
No vault seeding/restore/sync or service-worker changes
